title: Took money
body: The app did not ask me to confirm my purchase. Took information without asking. Absolutely shocking to do for a wellness app. €100 gone from my account. You should really look into this issue.

title: If I could give it zero stars I would - do not download
body: This app is an utter scam. Didn’t work once from the moment I downloaded it and charged me €36.99 despite it not appearing anywhere in my subscriptions list. When I tried to contact their customer support team they were totally useless and refused to remedy the situation in any way, shape or form. An absolute scam. Do not download.
